items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who were in some of these different bands like, uh, Joe Phillips and Joe Robichaux. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Joe Phillips?

ctx.x: Who were in some of these different bands like, uh, Joe Phillips and Joe Robichaux.
I, I didn't play it too. But, no, not Johnny. What did you say? Which kind of Phillips? Bill. Bill Phillips. Oh, I'm getting confused. There's so many Phillips.
